title: RevokeAiConnection
description: device -> server, sent on an established (challenge-verified) connection to revoke one of the account signed in on this phone's AI connections. The server answers with `ai_connection_revoked`; when the phone is signed out it answers with ok: false and error code "not_signed_in", and when connection_id isn't one of the account signed in on this phone's connections with "not_found".

connection_id.description: The client_id of the connection to revoke, as listed in ai_connections_list.
